description: Which way to follow the defining-SQL dependencies of a table or view when building its lineage.

enum.name: UPSTREAM
enum.description: The tables and views the object is built from, and what they are built from in turn.

enum.name: DOWNSTREAM
enum.description: The materialized views and search indexes built from the object, and what is built from them in turn.

enum.name: BOTH
enum.description: Both upstream and downstream. Siblings (other objects built from the same source) are not included.
